items.title: Darius Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 29, 2024
items.q: renting Irving Townsend’s house on Newtown Turnpike

ctx.x: Well that was a real uprooting. I remember it very clearly because it was 1960, it was a presidential year. Kennedy was elected. Kennedy ran against Nixon and won. Barry Goldwater was a big name in those days. And for me that just flags up so many historical things. But mainly what I remember was moving into a different, very different physical environment.
